thread:
Ravi: Heads-up: proposal to shorten SIEM raw-export retention in primary S3 from 400d -> 90d. Goal: reduce PII blast radius and storage spend. We need a locked, auditable preserve path for IR/legal to get 1y+ snapshots. Ideas?
Nina: Suggest Object Lock for preserved copies + tag-based controller to flip copies into locked bucket on approval. Legal: COMPLIANCE vs GOVERNANCE? Legal prefers COMPLIANCE for subpoenaed data.
Carlos: KMS note: use envelope encryption w/ CMK. No long-lived decrypt keys. Create per-request, timeboxed KMS grants tied to ticket id and approver. CloudTrail will show GrantCreate/Decrypt.
Aisha: Partner listeners need historical access. Proposal: partner-view (masked) 365d, raw 90d. Nightly pipeline writes both; partner bucket uses partner CMK + cross-account role.
Ravi: Preserve flow sketch:
1) create ticket SEC-5400 with case_id and justification
2) on approval, controller copies objects to forensics-archive, adds tag x-case-id, applies Object Lock retention
3) unwraps require short-lived KMS grant + SSO-proxy presigned URL; every unwrap emits an indexed audit event
security-automation: created SEC-5400 "Retention shrink + preserve/unlock playbook" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-5400
Nina: We need explicit scrub rules for partner-view and Privacy signoff. Also Finance needs cost delta (S3 + KMS HSM) before we finalize.
Carlos: Audit pattern: CloudTrail KMS entries + S3 logs + internal security-index entry with fields: ts, event_type, case_id, object_key, requester, approver, grant_id, ticket_id. Example (string): {"ts":"2026-03-30T15:12:00Z","event":"snapshot_unwrap","case_id":"CASE-2026-901","requester":"carlos","approver":"legal_lead","grant_id":"g-abc123","object":"forensics/CASE-2026-901-20260329.tar.gz","ticket":"SEC-5400"}
Aisha: Test plan: staging expiry deny -> create object ttl=12s, wait 15s expect OPA deny; approval path -> copy to locked bucket, create grant, download -> assert CloudTrail + security-index entries. Also add a reconcile job to detect drift (objects that should be preserved but expired).
Legal: Draft legal-hold wording; if they insist on COMPLIANCE we need org-level process.
oncall-bot: Meeting #sec-retention-sync Fri 11am PT  invites: Ravi, Nina, Carlos, Aisha, Legal
Ravi: I'll open the PR with architecture diagram, OPA snippets, sample IAM policy for ephemeral KMS grants, and a ticket template. Posting in SEC-5400 comments later. :thumbsup:
